//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Weaker Spiderwebs -> Config

Enable Weaker Spiderwebs.//: Whether Weaker Spiderwebs is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart. Do not disable a mod that adds blocks or items to an existing world, they will be removed.

breakSpiderwebDelay.//: The delay in ms after walking in a spiderweb until it breaks. min: 0, max: 10,000
